text:
lia: Noticed an uptick in support pings. Customers complaining that the deprecation banner for v1 caused surprising routing to v1. looks like some clients re-negotiated and picked v1 even though v2 was healthy. anyone see this in traces?
omar: yes — we saw a cluster of short-lived requests where header negotiation returned 426 (deprecated) and client retried -> backend served v1. quota counters then incremented on both sides for a subset, making billing confusing.
mohit: reproduced in staging: when banner TTL is low, some SDKs fall back aggressively. logs: 
```
client -> negotiate: Accepts: v2
server -> negotiate: 426-deprecate-v1-header
client retry -> GET /v1/generate
```
casey: if negotiation returns a deprecation/notice code, should we route that through a separate path that doesn't count against v1 quota until user actually calls v1 endpoints? right now our attribution is the first successful route.
devon: agreeing. we should separate "advisory negotiation" from definitive fallback. two immediate fixes: 1) don't increment product quota on advisory responses; 2) console shows a "deprecation advisory" banner distinct from a hard deprecation.
lia: also saw oscillation where console pin autopurge triggers: pin_ttl=300s but we get churn because the negotiation->fallback sequence is fast and we treat it like a real route change. affinity_debounce_ms seems to be 10s in prod.
omar: telemetry shows collateral billing: ~0.3% of requests in a tenant got double-counted during a 15m window. not huge but unacceptable.
mohit: proposed policy: treat negotiation advisory as a 1xx/3xx style signal (informational). only on user-initiated v1 call do we attribute to v1. implement a short client-side hold to avoid immediate retry.
casey: on the routing side I'd like a flag: negotiation_mode: [advisory|strict]. default advisory for deprecations. Also add a quota_attribution_mode: [first_success|sticky]. sticky recommended: once the tenant is pinned we attribute until pin expires.
devon: UX request: console needs a per-tenant "attribution inspector" that shows last N route decisions and why (negotiation, error fallback, pin). can we inject a compact timeline?
telemetry-bot: (auto) linked: https://internal.metrics/routing/1759609999 (flip-rate, quota-anomalies) :bar_chart:
omar: ops concern: if we change attribution semantics, billing reconciliation must be handled. finance needs a grace window. can we add a shadow-counter that tracks current vs reconciled counts for 7 days?
mohit: yes we can emit both counters: routed_count.v1_shadow, routed_count.v1_billed. reconciliation job will run daily.
lia: implementation plan: 
- deploy negotiation advisory handling behind FF (casey)
- switch quota attribution to sticky_shadow for 48hrs behind FF (mohit)
- console: add "attribution inspector" mock (devon)
- telemetry: alert if shadow_diff > 0.1% of total for a tenant (omar)

casey: quick config sketch: 
```
routing:
  negotiation_mode: advisory
  affinity_debounce_ms: 15000
  pin_ttl_secs: 600
  quota_attribution_mode: sticky_shadow
```
devon: UX note: add a "pause deprecation banners for tenant" emergency toggle for support to prevent churn while we investigate. must be gated and auditable.
omar: alerting: create an anomaly alert: if routed_count.v1_shadow - routed_count.v1_billed > 1000 in 10m -> p2 page ops and notify #billing.
mohit: testing: will add unit tests to ensure advisory negotiation does not increment v1 routed counter; add e2e with an SDK variant that retries aggressively.
lia: timeline: small FF rollout tomorrow morning, telemetry alert and shadow counters by EOD, console mock next week.
casey: add a short runbook entry: if shadow_diff spikes, flip negotiation_mode -> strict temporarily and pause banners for affected tenants.
devon: linking relevant doc: https://internal/docs/deprecations/best-practices :link: also recommend we coordinate copy change to make advisory less actionable for SDKs.
lia: thanks all. I'll open the FF and link PRs here.
telemetry-bot: (auto) thread archived to "deprecation-attribution" project
